name: The Sireya Desaru Coast
positioning: A suites-only rainforest and beachside retreat on Desaru Coast, listed on Mandarin Oriental's site as Mandarin Oriental, Desaru Coast
best_for: Travelers who want a private plunge pool and a quiet coastal base within reach of Singapore
Families wanting connecting suites or a two-bedroom suite

facts.text: Mandarin Oriental's own site lists the resort as Mandarin Oriental, Desaru Coast.
The resort is described as a rainforest retreat on Desaru Coast, where jungle meets the sea.
The suites are inspired by the charm of a traditional Malay village.
Ambara restaurant serves Mediterranean and Malaysian cuisine.
Dusky Monkey Bar offers daily afternoon tea to all guests.
Essential is a pool-side cafe serving contemporary international cuisine.
OFYR Dinner is a private BBQ dinner by the beach.
The fitness centre has Technogym equipment.
The resort has tennis and padel courts.
The Els Club Desaru Coast golf course is just moments from the resort.

highlights.text: The Ocean Front Junior Suite has direct beach access.
The Two-Bedroom Ocean Grand Suite has a king room that connects to a twin, ideal for families of up to six.
Ambara's menu features honey collected from the rainforests and herbs picked from the Chef's Garden.
The open-air Yoga Pavilion looks out over the South China Sea.
Lumare Beach House & Sports Club is listed as a Mediterranean dining and sports venue opening in November 2026.

considerations.text: Singapore Changi Airport is approximately two hours from the resort by car.
Kuala Lumpur International Airport is approximately a 4 hour drive from the resort.
The minimum age to access the spa facilities and fitness centre is 16.
WhataHotel notes the remote coastal location requires travel from major cities.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
